title: B2-EMIF AXI4 到 512-bit Avalon-MM 适配与 CDC
model_selection: 派单时省略 model；平台默认 gpt-5.6-luna[max]
model_scope: 只实现平台适配层的 AXI4 Full 128-bit 到 512-bit Avalon-MM 宽度聚合、CDC 和 calibration gate 模块级闭环；不实现 Cache/L2/CPU/SoC、B0 厂商输入修改或 Quartus 工程

complex_planner.scope: 若 AXI4/Avalon 宽度聚合、异步 FIFO 或 calibration/error 边界出现架构歧义，再补充一次边界拆解；不扩大写集

review.scope: 只审 task JSON、AXI4/B0 冻结 profile、目标 diff 和独立验证结果；检查 4-beat→512-bit 聚合、byteenable、waitrequest/readdatavalid、CDC/reset/calibration/error，不提供逐行实现

blocking_before_acceptance: 保持 Qsys addressUnits=WORDS、64B Avalon word、128MiB窗口和明确的 AXI→Avalon 地址公式。
跨64B事务返回本地 DECERR；Qsys 无 error/response 时正常后端映射 OKAY，本地错误映射 DECERR。
waitrequest_n 低时保持 payload，双域 reset flush inflight，cal_fail 粘滞且不发 Avalon。
review_record.boundary: 允许 owner 只实现 T-054 通用 RTL 与独立 SV/Cocotb L0/L1；不修改 B0 目录、不接 Cache/L2/CPU/SoC。

address.range: offset 0..0x07ffffff maps to Avalon word 0..0x1fffff; outside window returns local DECERR

boundary.supported: AXI INCR LEN<=3, SIZE<=4, each beat and complete burst remain within one 64B line
boundary.canonical: aligned 64B/4-beat request maps beat0 to Avalon writedata[127:0]/byteenable[15:0] and beat3 to [511:384]/[63:48]
boundary.narrow_wstrb: each beat WSTRB is shifted by (axi_addr & 0x3f) into the 64-bit Avalon byteenable
boundary.cross_line: any beat or burst crossing a 64B boundary is rejected with local DECERR; B2 does not silently split it

error.backend: Qsys Avalon interface has no error/response port; an accepted backend read/write that returns normally maps to AXI OKAY
error.local: address/window, unsupported burst, calibration failure, FIFO/reset protocol failure map to AXI DECERR; BFM must not invent an EMIF error port

reset.assertion: cpu and EMIF domains independently asynchronous-assert and synchronously release
reset.inflight: reset flushes both CDC queues and all in-flight state; no stale B/R or Avalon request is emitted after release; an in-flight transaction is reset-aborted and upstream restarts it
reset.invariant: no old response/data may cross a reset boundary

calibration.not_ready: cal_success=0 and cal_fail=0 backpressures new AXI requests
calibration.fail: cal_fail latches until reset, accepts new requests only into a local DECERR response path, and never issues Avalon traffic
calibration.post_accept_fail: a failure after acceptance is treated as reset-class abort; no stale response is permitted

avalon_handshake.waitrequest_n: active-low; hold read/write/address/writedata/byteenable/burstcount while low; accept only when high
avalon_handshake.read: accepted read waits independently for readdatavalid before producing AXI RVALID
